title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Radio City Music Hall, New York City | 2018
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Radio City Music Hall in New York City, USA, on 13 September 2018.

It was the 32nd show by the 13th All-Starr Band. Their tour of Europe and North America lasted for 44 dates between June and September 2018.

Starr previously performed at the Radio City Music Hall on 19 and 20 June 1992, 13 July 1995, 29 July 2003, 20 July 2006, 24 June 2008, and 7 July 2010. He returned there on 13 June 2025.

The 13th All-Starr Band

  • Graham Gouldman (10cc): bass guitar, vocals
